## Publish Listing (PL)

The single writer for a property listing’s go-live: a listing may not publish half-dressed — address, asking price, and at least one photo are enforced (photo-less listings do not get viewings). Later lifecycle moves are status edits; the publish moment never rewrites.

### Example

Natural target: the linked 14 Birchwood Lane (already live — re-running demonstrates the once-only guard).

### Non-goals

No portal syndication, no scheduled publishing.

cardInfo.name: Publish Listing
cardInfo.summary: Validates address, price, and ≥1 photo, then flips draft → published and stamps publishedAt once.
